newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread to sell Keg chain in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread to sell Keg chain in Canada.

text.p: Brewer to leisure group Whitbread Plc said it plans to sell its 81-strong Keg restaurant chain in Canada and the north west of the U.S.
Whitbread did not disclose any values for the business or if it was in talks with interested parties, although a company spokesman said "the amount would not be material to the overall business."

"It's a question of priorities," said David Thomas, managing director of Whitbread's restaurants and leisure division. "We believe there are better prospects for Whitbread in concentrating our resources on our existing brands and on our recent acquisitions. These provide us with major oppurtunities for growth in the UK and mainland Europe."
Analysts estimate Whitbread's overseas interests account for about 0.5 percent of annual profits. The company sold its 16 Keg restaurants in Australia last year.
